projects.title: MATCHA_w0r1d!
projects.bodyText: Designed a Misc CTF challenge for the 31st PoC HackingCamp — my first '1 solved' challenge.
projects.detailBody:
### 🚩 The 31st PoC Hacking Camp CTF — Misc Challenge

Designed and implemented an advanced Misc challenge, **'MATCHA w0r1d!'**, for a national-level Capture The Flag (CTF) competition hosted at the 31st PoC HackingCamp. Also worked as an official staff member and manager of 2 additional Web Security challenges during the camp.

My first challenge to receive only a single solve during the competition!

projects.title: UCSD Qualcomm Institute 14th AI Development Project 🏆
projects.bodyText: Team leader for a used-car price prediction ML project — 3rd place at Qualcomm Institute Hackathon + KCC 2025 Honorable Mention.
projects.detailBody:
🏆 **UCSD Qualcomm Institute AI Hackathon — 3rd place**
🏆 **KCC 2025 (Korea Computer Congress) — Honorable Mention Award**

Participated as team leader for a machine learning development project on **'Final Listing Price Prediction for Private Used Car Sellers'**, earning 3rd place at the 14th Qualcomm Institute Hackathon.

Wrote a first-author paper on this topic, *'Development of a Machine Learning-based Prediction Model for Used Car Listing Price in Germany'*, for KCC 2025 — receiving an Honorable Mention Award.

[Read the school's interview article →](https://www.sookmyung.ac.kr/kr/news/award-news.do?mode=view&articleNo=90412)
